ui.title: Fish Wish
ui.subtitle: An interactive story. About five minutes.
ui.soundNote: Sound helps; headphones are best. Press M to mute at any time.
ui.controlsNote: Move the light with your mouse, your finger, or the arrow keys. P pauses, S skips ahead.
ui.digHint: Hold and drag to brush the earth away. With a keyboard, hold Space.
ui.continue: Click or press Enter to go on.
ui.imagined: The mother, the father and the child in this story are imagined. The words of the face are imagined too.

story.digLong: It has been so long. The fires went out. The voices went away.
story.digCareful: Careful. The little one is sleeping under me.
story.dontBeAfraid: Don't be afraid of me. I was painted for you.
story.motherMade: Your mother made me the night you went quiet.
story.fishToHold: She gave me fish to hold, so you would never be hungry.
story.motherSoul: Your mother said it was for your soul, so you could come and go.
story.fatherBreathe: Your father said it was so you could still breathe. Just in case.
story.notTheField: They did not take you to the field beyond the ditch, where the grown-ups sleep.
story.byTheDoor: They kept you here, by the door.
story.everyMorning: Every morning she lit the fire, and the smoke went up over you.
story.eyesClosed: She painted my eyes closed, so you could sleep.
story.promise: I was never a monster. I was a promise.
story.stillDoes: Someone loved you. Someone still does.

inspired.text: A story inspired by a 6,000-year-old basin from Banpo, China. The people are imagined. The basin is real.

found.text: The basin with a human face and fish was found at Banpo, near Xi'an, in 1955. It is about 6,000 years old and is held by the National Museum of China.

inside.text: Its face is painted on the inside. Basins like it covered the burial jars of small children; none has been found in an adult grave.

buried.text: Children's jars were buried near the houses. Adults were buried in a cemetery outside the village, beyond the ditch.

hole.text: Many basins used as lids have a small hole, drilled or knocked through. One reading: a way for the soul to come and go. Another reading: a hope that the child might still breathe.

meaning.text: No one knows for sure what the face means. Readings include a shaman, a wish for many children, and a call to a small soul.

sources.title: What is real
method: The face and fish here are drawn in code from written descriptions. No museum photograph was traced or used, and no image was generated by AI.

The music and the sounds of the earth are synthesized in your browser. The voice of the face was generated with Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5-TTS (the voice called Chloe), then shaped in code: a lower shadow voice and the ring of a clay jar at first, fading until only the clear voice is left.
